Definition: {properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what}
BiblicalUsage: Mah is the Aramaic question word, what, how, why, and it asks the biggest questions in Daniel and Ezra. Daniel 2:22 says God knoweth what is in the darkness, and Daniel 4:35 says none can stay His hand or say unto Him, what doest thou? Ezra 7:23 commands whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven to be diligently done.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the what in Daniel 2:22 is the comfort: God knows what is in the darkness, even when I do not.
